title: Introducing Miller Finance Solutions
summary: Current news and information related to Miller Industries products and services.
body_markdown:
## Financing towing and recovery equipment just got easier.


Miller Industries has partnered with Commercial Fleet Financing to launch[Miller Finance Solutions](https://www.millerind.com/r/MFS26) , a financing program developed specifically for the towing and recovery industry. By combining our industry-leading equipment and distributor network with CFF’s financing expertise and technology, the program is designed to provide a faster, simpler and more competitive equipment-buying experience.


Customers will have access to:


- A streamlined application and approval process
- A broader range of credit options
- Flexible financing structures
- Discounted program rates
- Payment options designed for towing businesses


Whether you are purchasing your first truck, replacing aging equipment or expanding your fleet, Miller Finance Solutions can help you move from equipment selection to financing and delivery with greater speed and confidence.


“At Miller Industries, our commitment has always been to provide towing and recovery professionals with the highest-quality equipment and the support they need to succeed,” said Vince Tiano, Vice President of Miller Industries. “Through Miller Finance Solutions, we're making it easier for customers to access the financing they need to invest in their businesses and acquire the equipment necessary to grow and serve their customers more effectively.”


More information:[Miller Finance Solutions](https://www.millerind.com/r/MFS26)
